field_definitions.submitted_link: The link.amazon URL as supplied by the site owner.
field_definitions.submitted_token: The path token of the submitted link (characters after the domain).
field_definitions.intended_asin: The ASIN the owner intends this link to point to. Left blank: it cannot be confirmed from the supplied data (see F-01 and Q-04).
field_definitions.official_listing_url: The amazon.com /dp/ page that the observed redirect reached, with the ASIN taken from its URL path.
field_definitions.observed_asin: The ASIN in the /dp/ path of the page the redirect reached. Kept separate from intended_asin.
field_definitions.observed_redirect_target: The full URL the fetch tool reported after following the submitted link. Kept as observed.
field_definitions.tag_observed_in_redirect: Whether a tag= parameter appeared in observed_redirect_target. Checked by reading the stored URL.
field_definitions.price_observed: Buy Box price shown on the captured page. Changes over time and by delivery location.
field_definitions.rating: Product rating from the product's own summary section. Protection-plan ratings shown on the same pages are not used.
field_definitions.review_count: Review count shown with the product rating.
